goal: 向警方清晰描述事故经过并配合调查

n1.speaker: 警官 Officer Chen
n1.line: Good evening. Sitting down first, could you calmly tell me what happened at the crossroads?
n1.lineCn: 晚上好。您先坐下,能冷静地告诉我十字路口发生了什么吗?

grammar.name: 现在分词作伴随状语
grammar.note: Sitting down first 作伴随状语,说明说活时的同时动作,逻辑主语为 you。

options.text: Yes, officer. Driving home from work, I reached the crossroads around six o'clock.
options.textCn: 好的警官。我下班开车回家,六点左右到达十字路口。
options.feedback: 基本信息清楚,笔录开始。

options.text: I am too shaken to recall anything clearly. Everything happened so fast.
options.textCn: 我受惊过度,什么都记不清。一切发生得太快了。

options.text: I was not there myself, but I heard the crash from my apartment.
options.textCn: 我不在现场,但从公寓听到了撞击声。

n2.speaker: 警官 Officer Chen
n2.line: Take your time. Seeing the traffic light change, what did you do next?
n2.lineCn: 别着急。看到交通灯变化后,您接下来做了什么?

grammar.name: 现在分词作时间状语
grammar.note: Seeing the traffic light change 相当于 when I saw...,表时间先后,使叙事紧凑。

options.text: Seeing the light turn green, I started to move forward slowly.
options.textCn: 看到绿灯亮起,我缓缓启动向前。

options.text: Noticing the truck speeding towards me, I slammed on the brakes.
options.textCn: 注意到卡车朝我疾驰而来,我猛踩刹车。

options.text: I honestly cannot remember whether the light was green or red.
options.textCn: 老实说,我记不清灯是绿是红。
options.feedback: 记忆模糊,警官引导回忆。

n2b.speaker: 警官 Officer Chen
n2b.line: Slowly, please. Turning back to that moment, was the light green for you as you passed the junction?
n2b.lineCn: 请放慢节奏。回想那一刻,您通过路口时灯是绿的吗?

grammar.name: 现在分词作时间状语(回想)
grammar.note: Turning back to that moment 作时间状语,引导回忆,叙事逻辑清晰。

options.text: Yes, it was green. Passing the junction, I noticed the truck approaching fast from the left.
options.textCn: 是的,是绿灯。通过路口时,我注意到卡车从左侧快速驶来。

options.text: It was green for me. Stopping at the line, I waited because the truck was still coming.
options.textCn: 对我来说是绿灯。停在停止线前,因为卡车还在驶来,我等待了。

options.text: I did not look at the light. Trusting the car in front, I simply followed it.
options.textCn: 我没看灯。我信任前车,只是跟着它走。
options.feedback: 未尽观察义务,警官提醒。

n3.speaker: 警官 Officer Chen
n3.line: Calm down, please. Having taken a deep breath, tell me the basic facts: time, place, and vehicles involved.
n3.lineCn: 请冷静。深呼吸之后,告诉我基本事实:时间、地点和涉及的车辆。

grammar.name: 现在分词完成式作状语
grammar.note: Having taken a deep breath 表示动作先于主句发生,相当于 after taking a deep breath。

options.text: Having calmed myself, I remember it was 6:05, right at the north corner of the crossing.
options.textCn: 镇定下来后,我记起是六点零五分,就在路口北角。

options.text: I was so frightened that I cannot even recall my own car number.
options.textCn: 我吓得连自己的车牌号都想不起来。
options.feedback: 仍处于慌乱,警官耐心引导。

options.text: I would rather wait for my lawyer before saying anything.
options.textCn: 说任何话之前,我想等律师来。

n4.speaker: 警官 Officer Chen
n4.line: You witnessed the accident. Being a witness, you have an obligation to describe what you saw.
n4.lineCn: 您是事故目击者。作为证人,您有义务描述您看到的情况。

grammar.name: 现在分词作原因状语
grammar.note: Being a witness 相当于 because you are a witness,表原因,语气正式。

options.text: Being a witness, I will tell you exactly what I saw: the truck ran the red light.
options.textCn: 作为证人,我会如实告诉您:卡车闯了红灯。

options.text: I only heard the sound. Fearing trouble, I stayed inside my apartment.
options.textCn: 我只听到了声音。因为怕惹麻烦,我一直待在公寓里。
options.feedback: 信息有限,警官继续询问。

options.text: I saw something, but I am not sure my memory is reliable.
options.textCn: 我看到了些东西,但不确定记忆是否可靠。
options.feedback: 谨慎表态,警官引导回忆。

n5.speaker: 警官 Officer Chen
n5.line: Very good. Based on your account, the truck appears to have ignored the signal. Now, what happened after you applied the brakes?
n5.lineCn: 很好。根据您的描述,卡车似乎无视了信号灯。那么,您踩下刹车后发生了什么?

grammar.name: 过去分词作状语(依据)
grammar.note: Based on your account 作条件/依据状语,相当于 according to,用于正式陈述。

options.text: Braking hard, I heard a loud crash behind me.
options.textCn: 急刹的同时,我听到身后一声巨响。

options.text: Turning to look back, I saw the truck hit the taxi at the junction.
options.textCn: 回头一看,我看见卡车在路口撞上了出租车。
options.feedback: 目睹关键画面,证词重要。

options.text: I did not see the collision itself. Hearing the crash, I stopped and called the police.
options.textCn: 我没亲眼看到撞击。听到撞击声,我停下车报警。

n5b.speaker: 警官 Officer Chen
n5b.line: I see. Judging from your description, you were about fifty metres behind the truck when it collided.
n5b.lineCn: 我明白了。根据您的描述判断,卡车相撞时您在后方约五十米处。

grammar.name: 现在分词作评注状语
grammar.note: Judging from your description 作独立评注状语,相当于 based on,是正式用词。

options.text: Roughly fifty metres. Seeing the crash clearly, I pulled over immediately.
options.textCn: 大约五十米。看清撞击后,我立刻靠边停车。
options.feedback: 距离准确,行为描述完整。

options.text: I am not good at distances. Guessing by the shops, perhaps two streetlights away.
options.textCn: 我不擅长估距离。按店铺推测,大约两个路灯远。

options.text: Being far behind, I only heard the impact rather than seeing it.
options.textCn: 因为距离远,我只听到撞击声,没看到撞击。

n6.speaker: 警官 Officer Chen
n6.line: Uncertain memories hinder the investigation. Checked against the camera footage, your words will be verified.
n6.lineCn: 模糊的记忆会妨碍调查。与监控录像核对后,您的话会得到验证。

grammar.name: 过去分词作条件状语
grammar.note: Checked against the camera footage 相当于 when your words are checked,表被动条件。

options.text: I will try my best. Exhausted as I was, I will still describe everything I remember.
options.textCn: 我会尽力。虽然精疲力尽,我仍会描述记得的一切。

options.text: I remember nothing, and I will not be forced to invent details.
options.textCn: 我什么都不记得,也不会被逼着编造细节。
options.feedback: 虽抵触但有理,继续沟通。

options.text: Give me a moment. Looking back at that moment, I recall the horn sounding twice.
options.textCn: 给我点时间。回想那一刻,我记得喇叭响了两声。
options.feedback: 细节逐渐浮现,记录在案。

n7.speaker: 警官 Officer Chen
n7.line: Your refusal to cooperate slows everything down. Standing in a court later, you will regret hiding information.
n7.lineCn: 您拒绝配合会让一切变慢。日后站在法庭上,您会后悔隐瞒信息。

grammar.name: 现在分词作时间状语(将来)
grammar.note: Standing in a court later 表将来时间,分词短语作状语使警告更具画面感。

options.text: You are right. Thinking it over, I will cooperate fully with your investigation.
options.textCn: 您说得对。想清楚后,我会全力配合调查。

options.text: I am not hiding anything, but feeling threatened, I choose to remain silent.
options.textCn: 我没隐瞒任何事,但因感到受威胁,我选择沉默。

options.text: You have convinced me to cooperate. I will tell you everything I remember.
options.textCn: 您说服了我。我会把记得的一切都告诉您。

n8.speaker: 警官 Officer Chen
n8.line: Good. One more detail: judging by the marks on the road, the truck braked far too late.
n8.lineCn: 好。还有一个细节:从路面痕迹判断,卡车刹车太晚了。

grammar.name: 现在分词作评注状语(判断)
grammar.note: Judging by the marks on the road 作评注性状语,表达推断依据,句式正式。

options.text: That matches what I saw. Slowing down at the corner, the truck still hit the taxi at full speed.
options.textCn: 这和我看到的一致。在拐角减速时,卡车仍以全速撞上出租车。

options.text: I cannot judge the speed, but seeing the truck from where I stood, it was certainly fast.
options.textCn: 我判断不了速度,但以我的位置看去,它确实很快。

options.text: I was not watching the truck. Feeling sleepy, I almost missed the whole event.
options.textCn: 我没在看那辆卡车。因为犯困,我差点错过整个过程。
options.feedback: 观察不力,证词价值降低。

n8b.speaker: 警官 Officer Chen
n8b.line: Noted. Arriving at the scene, did you notice anyone leaving in a hurry before the ambulance came?
n8b.lineCn: 记下了。到达现场时,您有没有注意到救护车到来前有人匆忙离开?

grammar.name: 现在分词作时间状语(到达)
grammar.note: Arriving at the scene 相当于 when you arrived at the scene,时间状语使提问自然。

options.text: Arriving at the scene, I noticed a man in a grey coat walking away quickly.
options.textCn: 到达现场时,我注意到一个穿灰外套的男人快步离开。
options.feedback: 提供关键线索,警方重视。

options.text: Seeing the injured driver, I ran to help instead of watching the crowd.
options.textCn: 看到受伤的司机,我跑去帮忙,而不是看热闹。
options.feedback: 行为值得肯定,继续询问。

options.text: Not noticing anyone special, I concentrated on calling the ambulance.
options.textCn: 没注意到特别的人,我专心打急救电话。

n9.speaker: 警官 Officer Chen
n9.line: That detail could be crucial. Given the importance of this case, any footage you recorded would help.
n9.lineCn: 这个细节可能至关重要。考虑到案件的重要性,您录下的任何影像都会有用。

grammar.name: 过去分词作原因状语
grammar.note: Given the importance of this case 相当于 considering,作原因/条件状语,正式用法。

options.text: Given the chance, I did film ten seconds of the scene with my phone.
options.textCn: 恰逢其时,我确实用手机拍下了十秒现场画面。

options.text: I did not film it. Seeing the chaos, my first thought was to help the injured.
options.textCn: 我没拍。看到一片混乱,我的第一反应是救助伤员。

options.text: I have the footage, but fearing involvement, I would rather not share it.
options.textCn: 我有影像,但怕惹麻烦,宁可不交出来。

n9b.speaker: 警官 Officer Chen
n9b.line: Your cooperation has been exemplary. Having heard your account, I believe we have enough to proceed.
n9b.lineCn: 您的配合堪称表率。听完您的陈述,我相信我们掌握的信息足以推进调查。

grammar.name: 现在分词完成式作状语(听完)
grammar.note: Having heard your account 表先于主句完成的动作,强调听完之后的结论。

options.text: Thank you, officer. Hoping to help the victim, I will also leave my contact number.
options.textCn: 谢谢警官。希望能帮助伤者,我也会留下联系电话。

options.text: I am glad it is over. Wishing to go home now, may I leave?
options.textCn: 很高兴结束了。想回家休息,我可以离开了吗?

options.text: I have said everything. Now, being exhausted, I refuse to answer further questions.
options.textCn: 我该说的都说了。现在精疲力尽,拒绝回答更多问题。
options.feedback: 善后不当,留下不良印象。

success.speaker: 警官 Officer Chen
success.line: Thank you for your cooperation. With your statement, we can reconstruct the accident precisely.
success.lineCn: 感谢您的配合。有了您的陈述,我们就能精确还原事故经过。

fail1.speaker: 警官 Officer Chen
fail1.line: I regret your decision. Withholding information may eventually bring you more trouble.
fail1.lineCn: 我对您的决定感到遗憾。隐瞒信息最终可能会给您带来更多麻烦。

fail2.speaker: 警官 Officer Chen
fail2.line: This statement is too vague to be useful. Please contact us again when you are ready to cooperate.
fail2.lineCn: 这份陈述太过模糊,难以发挥作用。请您愿意配合时再联系我们。
